title: My graduation cap runs Rust
summary: A developer shares their creative project of programming a graduation cap with Rust to display animated effects, demonstrating how Rust can be used for fun embedded hardware projects beyond traditional software development.
problem_solved: Makes graduation ceremonies more festive by turning a graduation cap into a programmable LED display running Rust code.
why_valuable: Showcases Rust's versatility in embedded contexts while providing an inspiring example for developers looking to combine creativity with code.
